note: Captured from the CHR test router. The entries were created FOR the capture, in the documentation range (TEST-NET-2, RFC 5737), and removed afterwards: one with a comment, a disabled subnet, a range in a second list, and one added with timeout=1d, which RouterOS makes DYNAMIC and reports with its remaining time. creation-time is replaced by a fixed value, since it is the moment of capture. What is real is the reply's shape: which fields /ip/firewall/address-list returns and how it spells them, and that an address may be a host, a subnet or a range. Read through /ip/firewall/address-list/print; tools/capture-fixtures.js cannot capture an area.
